note: Section 6/19/20: default-behavior regression -- with kv_dev_override unset (or set to a callback that always returns NULL, or always returns default_dev), behavior must be byte-identical to unpatched upstream.

product_cli_smoke_test.method: real build-vulkan/tools/membrane-run/membrane-run --model SmolLM2-135M --prompt Hello --ctx 2048 --gpu-layers all --gen-tokens 4 --json --quiet, with the patch applied but membrane-run never setting kv_dev_override at all

byte_identical_metrics_check.method: membrane-run --kv q8 --ctx 2048, SmolLM2-135M, compared field-by-field against the identical config's own earlier measurement

null_vs_always_null_vs_default_returning.method: membrane-kv-device-override-probe with three variants at identical model/ctx/kv_type/prompt/gen_tokens: (a) split=-1, cp.kv_dev_override never set at all (true NULL/unset field); (b) split=-2, a callback installed that ALWAYS returns NULL for every layer; (c) split=0, a callback installed that always resolves to default_dev via ordinary split logic
null_vs_always_null_vs_default_returning.conclusion: the patch's documented NULL-return safe-fallback contract is real and verified: an unset callback, an installed-but-always-NULL callback, and an installed-and-explicitly-default-choosing callback are all exactly equivalent in both placement and generated output.

no_new_visible_logs: the only new LLAMA_LOG_DEBUG line only fires INSIDE the if(kv_dev_override) block, which is skipped entirely when the field is unset -- no new debug or info-level output appears in the unset-callback path; the pre-existing 'layer %3d: dev = %s' debug line's TEXT is byte-identical to upstream when the override never changes buft (verified: the patch reuses the exact original format string unmodified).
